notes: net::http::cgi: the host Handler (environment construction, header parsing, internal redirects, error responses) and the child-side Request, RequestFromMap and Serve, verified against Go with scripted CGI programs and environments

Handler.note: a struct with public fields; implements http::Handler

Handler.Stderr.note: Option<Arc<Mutex<dyn Write + Send>>>; None is the parent's standard error

Handler.ServeHTTP.note: std::process would search PATH for a Path with no directory part, so the child is executed as ./Path; its argv[0] is Path itself (CommandExt::arg0), as in Go, verified with a real binary reporting its argv[0]

Serve.note: takes Option<&dyn Handler>; None is Go's nil, the default ServeMux. serve_with writes the response to a given writer instead of standard output
